description: Parking Enforcement is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire Insight. This page contains datasets about Cambridgeshire County Council's parking enforcement. The datasets contain figures showing the number of Penalty Charge Notices issued for on-street and off-street parking combined broken down by month and the income received through Penalty Charge Notices issued for on-street and off-street parking combined also broken down by month. Coverage: Cambridgeshire Insight. The portal files it under the publisher Cambridgeshire Insight. Its tags are parking. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-04-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
